summary_md: **ModelScope ([@ModelScope2022](https://x.com/ModelScope2022/status/2115685061521735987))** announces **Clover-35B-A3B-Preview** from DiffuSpace Labs, an open diffusion language model derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (35B total, ~3B active) with 128K context, claiming SOTA among open diffusion LMs and block-wise parallel decoding; weights are on ModelScope.
relevance: A new open diffusion-decoding model in the agent-friendly 35B-A3B shape, worth testing for local throughput.

media.description: Bar charts 'Clover-35B-A3B-Preview: Agentic Benchmarks' comparing DiffuSpace Clover 35B-A3B-Preview with LLaDA2.2 flash, Mercury 2.5, Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.5 35B-A3B; Clover leads on τ³ Overall 65.3, BFCL-v4 67.9, Terminal-Bench 2.1 51.7, Terminal-Hard 38.1, SWE-bench Verified 73.6 and SWE-Pro 46.5.

Full benchmark table comparing diffusion models (DiffuSpace Clover 35B-A3B-Preview, LLaDA2.2 flash, DiffusionGemma 26B A4B, Mercury 2.5) with autoregressive Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.5 35B-A3B across knowledge, math, code, reasoning, instruction following, long context, tool-agent, work-agent and coding-agent benchmarks.
media.ocr_text: Clover: GPQA Diamond 83.8, HLE 12.8, MMLU-Pro 84.8, MATH-500 96.2, AIME 2026 83.3, LiveCodeBench v6 72.6, SciCode 30.9, ZebraLogic 95.8, IFBench 72.3, AA-LCR 72.0, τ³ 65.3, BFCL-v4 67.9, GDPval-AA v2 1091, Terminal-Bench 2.1 51.7, Terminal-Hard 38.1, SWE-bench Verified 73.6, SWE-Pro 46.5. Coding agent benchmarks use the Terminus 2 harness for Terminal-Bench and the Codex harness for SWE-bench.
